items.title: Joe Wilder — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: They were beginning to leave Jimmie’s band: Trummy Young, Snooky Young, Gerald Wilson, Willie Smith, and all of them.

ctx.x: That was a good band. It was in the process of rebuilding at that time, because prior to my going into the service, I think it was at that point that most of the guys had left. They were beginning to leave Jimmie’s band: Trummy Young, Snooky Young, Gerald Wilson, Willie Smith, and all of them. They left the band. Willie went with – who did he go with? I think with Harry James. But they all left and went with other bands. Sy Oliver left and started writing for Tommy Dorsey. So Jimmie was in the process of…
Were you playing with the band then?
Who else was there this year? I didn't see the Lineup (inaudible)...

Well, the trombones was -- were Watrous, Rosolino, Carl Fontana, Vic Dickinson, myself, Al Grey, George Masso. And the trumpets were -- trumpets were Clark Terry, and Ruby Braff, Pee Wee Erwin, Joe Wilder, and Jon
